ig_caption:
Three numbers tell you if an agent is healthy 📊

Latency. Tokens. Flagged runs. Per agent, not per platform (pulled from Langfuse):
🤖 support agent: ~10s, ~500 tokens, 3 flags (1 failed lookup, 2 redacted emails)
🤖 ops agent: ~12s, ~500 tokens, 3 flags (all blocked restarts)
Same totals, very different stories.

⏱ latency: do users wait?
💸 tokens: your bill on a paid model
🚩 flags: where to look first

Part 2/4 of Agent Platform in Production. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
